_about: What the coach says around the manual's content. Plain data: edit freely. These lines must never state a fact about the work itself; every fact the coach teaches is quoted from manual.json. Each key is a list; the coach takes them in turn. {title}, {n}, {score}, {total}, {topics}, {lesson} are filled in by the app.
open: Let's work through {title}. I'll show you one idea at a time, then ask you about it.
This one is {title}. Short pieces, with a question after each.
{title}. Read each part the way you'd explain it to a vendor.
streak: {n} in a row. You know this part.
stuck: This one keeps tripping you up. Tap “I don't understand” and I'll show it another way.
Let's slow down on this one. “I don't understand” gives you another way into it.
simplerTip: Here's another way the manual puts it:
simplerLine: In one line, the manual says:
simplerNearest: That's all the manual says on this. The closest other part is {lesson}.
simplerNone: That's all the manual says on this. Try reading the whole chapter.
quizStart: Now a short quiz on the whole chapter: {n} questions.
nextReview: You missed questions on {topics}. I'd review those next.
nextAllDone: That's every lesson in the manual. Keep it fresh with the daily practice.
reviewStart: These are the ones you've missed before. The choices are in a different order this time.
reviewEmpty: Nothing to review. You haven't missed anything yet.
dailyEmpty: Start a lesson first, then there's something to practise.
dailyNothingDue: Nothing is due today. Everything you've answered is fresh.
dailyDone: Done for today: {score} out of {total}. See you tomorrow.
practiceStart: {n} questions on this. Take your time.
searchLead: Here's what the manual says, in {lesson}:
searchNoMatch: The manual doesn't seem to cover that. These lessons are the closest:
searchNoWords: The manual doesn't seem to cover that, and none of those words are in it. Try other words, or start with one of these lessons:
